data.description:
## Incident Overview

The cycle-6 fix for shell-into-python interpolation (env-var indirection) was applied to plugins/dso/hooks/lib/merge-helpers.sh but reviewer asserts that plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh and plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main.sh still contain `python3 -c "... json.load(open('$_state_file')) ..."`-style patterns. If true, the same shell-injection vector remains for branch names / state-file paths containing single quotes or shell metacharacters.

## Source

CI llm-review iteration 8 finding [9] on PR #37 (job 74100719710). Classified IMPORTANT — partial fix would leave the security regression open.

## Suggested Fix

Audit both files for `python3 -c` invocations that interpolate shell variables into the python source. Convert each to env-var passing with `os.environ['_DSO_X']`. Add a test that exercises the dispatcher with a malicious state-file path (e.g., containing `')\nimport os; os.system('touch /tmp/pwn')\n#`) and asserts no command execution.
data.title: merge-to-main-pr.sh + merge-to-main.sh: '$VAR' python interpolation -> incomplete env-var injection fix
